title: Oil spill from a broken pipe
question: How far from the leak does the oil come up, and how does droplet size (dispersant) change that?
line: A pipeline on the seabed, 100 m down, has ruptured and is leaking crude oil. The oil leaves as a cloud of droplets. Oil is lighter than seawater (about 860 against 1025 kg/m³), so every droplet rises
